title: Value of the single-coordinate flip at the flipped coordinate
statement: Let $n \in \bbn$, let $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ be a coordinate index, and let $x$ be an $n$-bit Boolean input. The single-coordinate flip of $x$ at $i$ — the input obtained from $x$ by negating its $i$-th coordinate and leaving all others unchanged — has value $\neg\,x_i$ at coordinate $i$.
